scope: Corollary 7.2 (Mixed determinant-gradient and affine Sobolev inequalities) of the manuscript “Petty’s projection-volume conjecture in dimensions at least four” (preprints/Pettys-projection-volume-conjecture-in-dimensions-at-least-four-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 088 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce25657d3f42aebb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 3 be an integer, put q = n/(n − 1), and let f1, . . . , fn ∈ C1 c (Rn) be nonnegative. Then Dn(f1, . . . , fn) ≥ n! κ n n−1κ 2−n n n ∏ i=1 ∥fi∥q . (63) In particular, every nonnegative f ∈ C1 c (Rn) satisfies the affine L1 Sobolev inequality Dn(f, . . . , f )1/n ≥ (n!)1/n κn−1κ (2−n)/n n ∥f ∥q . (64) Both constants are sharp in this class, through smooth approximation of ellipsoid indicators in BV(Rn); no equality assertion for nonzero C1 c functions is made.
